_about: Music (src/audio/music.js; picks + tools in docs/systems/sound.md MUSIC). screens: which track each screen plays; a LIST = those tracks take turns (each plays its intro + loop once, then fades into the next). tracks: file in src/assets/music/<file>.mp3, loopStart = seconds where the repeating part starts (it repeats to the end of the file), written by docs/proposals/music/make-game-music.py. volume = music loudness at MUSIC 10 (the Settings bar scales it; 0.5 drowned the sound effects, user: now 0.2). null = silence (boss floors: silent until the boss's roar is over, then 'boss' (BattleScene.startFighting); descent: the squad song fades out on BEGIN DESCENT). fadeSec = crossfade between screens, BATTLE FLOORS (session 57, user: 'RPG 8 and 10 in the game, extend randomly, play right after each other with a breathing room in the mid'): the list takes turns; each turn the song repeats a random whole number of times in turnRepeats [min, max], fades out over turnEndFadeSec at the end of its last repeat, then turnGapSec of silence, then the other song starts at full energy. The defeat screen (GameOverScene) changes nothing: the floor's song plays on.
